title: fix(plugin-charts): the radar mark consults the series (objectui#8157)
body:
Fixes #8157

The radar arm of `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` rendered a bare `fillOpacity={0.6}` and read
nothing off the series, while every cartesian arm resolved its presentation through the
shared `seriesStyle` helper. Three things `@objectstack/spec` declares for every
`ChartSeries` were therefore inert on `chartType: 'radar'` at once — `opacity` and
`dashArray` (both read by `normalizeSeries`, then discarded) and the whole
`variant: 'comparison'` treatment, which is declared and documented with no family
restriction.

## Anchors re-derived by content, because they had already moved twice

The card measured `c14d3a090`, triage re-measured `83d4fda16`, the dispatch re-measured
`592402ea3` — and on `592402ea3` the helper had moved once more. Everything below was
found by content, not by address:

| thing | found by | reading on `592402ea3` |
|---|---|---|
| the helper | `const seriesStyle = (s: any, kind:` | one definition |
| its call sites | `grep -c "seriesStyle("` | **5**, one per cartesian arm |
| the radar path | the `chartType === 'radar'` branch | **0** call sites |
| the literal | `fillOpacity={0.6}` | one, inside the radar mark |

The control the dispatch called the sharp fact holds exactly as stated: five cartesian
call sites, zero on the radar path. One premise did move again and is reported below.

## What changed

- The radar arm calls `seriesStyle(s, 'radar')` and passes `strokeOpacity` and
  `strokeDasharray` through to the mark as well as `fillOpacity`. Radar is a stroked
  mark (`stroke={color}` sits right above the literal), so unlike a bar or a scatter
  this is a family where a dash actually paints.
- `seriesStyle` gained `'radar'` in its `kind` union and an `areaLike` binding. Radar
  takes the **area** family's muted defaults because it is the other mark this renderer
  both strokes and fills — no new numbers were invented for it.
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx`: three rows of the per-series options table
  said this renderer strokes `line` and `area` marks. That sentence is falsified by this
  change, so radar joins it there, and in the `opacity` and `variant` rows.

## The fallback, which is the decision this card actually asks for

`0.6` was a DEFAULT as much as a bug — a radar fill needs some opacity or an overlay is
unreadable — so the literal became the fallback rather than being deleted:

```tsx
fillOpacity={pres.fillOpacity ?? 0.6}
```

⇒ **a radar series declaring none of the three keys paints exactly what it painted
before**: `fill-opacity` `0.6`, no stroke fade, no dash. That is the answer triage asked a
claimant to state, and it is pinned from both sides in the new test. Already-drawn radar
charts that author nothing are untouched; only a chart that authors one of the keys
changes, which is the repair.

## No cartesian arm changed

`areaLike` is `kind === 'area' || kind === 'radar'`, so for every cartesian kind it is
exactly `kind === 'area'` and every existing branch keeps its own value. Measured rather
than argued: `ChartRenderer.seriesPresentation.test.tsx` (the objectui#7698 pin, 13 cases
over bar / line / area / scatter / combo, both variants) is green **on both legs** of the
reverse verification below — with the helper edit and without it.

## Pin — three reds, with the control green on both sides

`packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.radarSeriesPresentation-8157.test.tsx`. It
asserts on the rendered polygon's attributes, never on the helper's return value: the
helper was not on this path at all, which was the entire defect, so a unit test of the
helper would have passed on the broken tree.

Reverse verification, run from the committed state (`git checkout 592402ea3 -- ...`
restores the pre-fix file; restore leg is `git checkout HEAD -- ...`, proved by the blob
hash returning to the HEAD blob and by an empty `git diff HEAD`). The mutation was proved
to have landed on disk before the run was read: `seriesStyle(s, 'radar')` count 1 to 0,
and the mutated blob hash differs from the HEAD blob hash.

| case | pre-fix / ablated | with the fix |
|---|---|---|
| authored `opacity` reaches both channels | RED — painted `0.6` / absent | green — `0.25` / `0.25` |
| authored `dashArray` dashes the outline | RED — `stroke-dasharray` absent | green — `2 6` |
| `variant: 'comparison'` mutes the overlay | RED — identical to the primary | green — `0.2` / `0.6` / `4 4` |
| authored keys override the comparison default | RED | green — `0.9` / `0.9` / `8 4` |
| **control**: a series declaring none of the three | **green** — `0.6`, no fade, no dash | **green** — unchanged |
| **control**: the primary beside a comparison overlay | **green** | **green** |

Ablated run: `Tests 4 failed | 15 passed (19)` — the 4 reds, and 15 green made up of the
2 controls plus the whole objectui#7698 cartesian pin.

## Verification

All readings below are from the final head `869c3160a` (after `origin/main` was merged in).

| command | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/` | `Test Files 64 passed (64)` · `Tests 569 passed (569)` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` | exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts lint` | exit 0 — `358 problems (0 errors, 358 warnings)`, all pre-existing |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 — declares `.changeset/8157-radar-series-presentation.md` |
| `check:control-bytes` · `check:new-line-citations` · `check:changeset-claims` | exit 0 |
| `check:doc-fences` · `check:doc-types` · `check:test-path-roots` | exit 0 |
| `check:vi-mock-specifiers` · `check:vi-mock-inherit` · `check:vi-mock-override-shape` | exit 0 |
| `check:pending-changeset-literals` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (the 4 paths) | `NOT GOVERNED` |

The dependency closure was built first (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter
'@object-ui/plugin-charts^...' build`); before it, `type-check` reported only
`Cannot find module '@object-ui/core'` and friends, which is an unbuilt tree rather than a
finding.

**Declared narrowing.** `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` are NOT MEASURED
here: both refuse to run until 34 packages are built, and building them locally for a
documentation check costs a long hold on the shared serialisation lock. The narrowing is
provable rather than hopeful — `git diff -U0` on the `.mdx` shows three markdown table
rows changed and zero fence lines touched, so no TypeScript block in any document moved.
CI owns both gates.

## Relationship to objectui#7698 and objectui#7546

- objectui#7698 is the `variant` gate and the Bar / Scatter marks inside the helper's own
  coverage; its census classified this literal as "a literal constant", deliberately
  outside its measured surface. It is untouched here and stays as it is.
- `check:changeset-claims` flagged one pending changeset that names this file —
  `.changeset/7546-chart-series-keys-declared.md`, whose body says the six keys "do real
  work in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`", with `opacity` / `dashArray` setting stroke and fill.
  Read as a paragraph: this change makes that sentence **more** true, not less — before
  it, the claim was silently overstated for one family. No correction is needed and none
  was made.

## Acceptance notes

Noted while in this file, deliberately not filed and not fixed here:

- `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` carries cross-file line-address citations into
  this package's `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` and `normalizeChartSchema.ts`, and
  `.changeset/7546-chart-series-keys-declared.md` carries another into
  `normalizeChartSchema.ts`. The addresses are deliberately not reproduced here — one of
  them points into a span this diff shifts, which is the rot AGENTS.md #11 describes.
  That rule bans the form outright but rules the repair **opportunistic, never a sweep**,
  so it belongs to whoever next edits those files rather than to this PR, and no card is
  warranted by the rule's own wording. This change adds none:
  `check:new-line-citations` reports `0 new citation(s)`.
- Re-grade probe from triage: a grep for authored radar metadata carrying `opacity`,
  `dashArray` or `variant: 'comparison'` finds none in this repo's docs, fixtures or
  examples, so the p3 grade stands.
